caption:
Your ad spend doesn't know how fast you call back.

Your close rate does.

The Ad ROI Calculator takes your ad spend, your lead count, and your close rate, and turns them into one number: cost per booked job.

Most owners run it once. Run it twice instead.

1. Enter your real numbers. Note your current cost per booked job.

2. Run it again with your close rate doubled.

3. The gap between those two numbers is what slow follow-up is costing you right now.

That second number isn't a guess. Answering a lead in under 5 minutes instead of an hour-plus roughly doubles close rate.

Most businesses never close that window. Only about 17% answer within the first hour.

rationale: Single-offer promo images still book the fastest DM response, and reframing the Ad ROI Calculator as a two-run speed-to-lead gap test ties it directly to the brand's core thesis without repeating prior cost-per-lead framings.
